description:
Computer Equipment and Network Technician

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Computer Equipment and Network Technician to join our dynamic team. As a Computer Equipment and Network Technician, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation of our cash register systems and networks. This is an exciting opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology and contribute to the success of our organization.

Responsibilities:

  • Install, configure, and maintain cash register and network equipment.
  • Diagnose and resolve hardware issues
  • Cash register audit support / technical support: employee mobile phones, landline phones, laptops, PCs, servers/routers; technical support for hardware and procurement
  • Monitor network performance and troubleshoot network problems
  • Collaborate with collegues from IT Departament from TEDi Germany
  • Provide technical support to end-users and assist as needed
  • Contact person for problems with cash register systems; cashless payment transactions and mobile data processing
  • Document and maintain accurate records of system configurations and changes.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience as a Computer Equipment and Network Technician or similar role.
  • Strong knowledge of computer hardware, software, and network systems.
  • Proficient in troubleshooting and resolving technical issues.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Relevant certifications are a plus.
  • Excellent English language skills
  • Knowledge of German language is an advantage
  • Driving licence category B is a must

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity for professional growth and development
  • Flexible work schedule.
  • Positive and inclusive work environment.

If you are a dedicated and skilled Computer Equipment and Network Technician looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity, we would love to hear from you. Apply now to join our team!
